newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha slightly firmer in dull market.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha slightly firmer in dull market.

text.p: NWE naphtha was steady on Monday as the market slowly awakened following a series of public holidays which put trade on hold for most of last week, traders said.
They attributed the slightly firmer prices to gains in related crude futures, but actual trade was close to non-existent.
High paraffinic material was heard offered out of Teeside, U.K., and smallish fob parcels were also reported on offer out of Antwerp and Rotterdam -- although no clear price levels emerged.
Last week, a 25,000 tonne pipeline spec cargo traded at around $175 a tonne cif NWE.
Swaps were slightly firmer with June paper quoted at $183/$185 a tonne and May at around $180/$181 a tonne.
